releases.notes:

While it's listed, that server receives your IP, the time and your game version whenever the list is shown: the Multiplayer screen and the launcher's Worlds tab. releases.notes:
Emotes and a new wardrobe. Minecraft 26.3, Fabric.

**Wardrobe**
- A new wardrobe, opened from the button under your player model on the title screen: a skin library, saved outfits and your account's capes, with a 3D preview. Add skins from a file, a URL or a username, then press Wear to upload one to Mojang.

**Emotes**
- Hold B for the emote wheel, point at an emote and let go. Eight starter emotes are included. Wave, Cheer, Point, Clap, Facepalm and T-Pose keep playing while you walk.
- **Sync** (Emotes tab, off by default) shows your emotes to other Nexo players on the same server, and theirs to you. Only Nexo players with Sync on can see them.

**Emote Shop** (the wardrobe's Shop tab, off by default)
- Earn coins by playing: 1 a minute up to 120 a day, a daily bonus, and a 7-day streak reward. Coins can't be bought with money.
- Browse emotes by rarity, preview them on your own skin, and watch for limited-time emotes and deals.
- Turning it on signs you in and stores a keyed hash of your account, your coins and emotes, and your minutes played per day for 30 days. The screen says so before you agree, and Erase removes it all.

**Fixes**
- Joining a full server could get your IP blocked from Nexo's website and services for a few minutes.
- Sign-in to Nexo's services works again: Mojang had started refusing the old request format.
- Essential's title-screen buttons keep fixed positions, which may fix them jumping around on Windows.

**Known issues**
- Badge sign-up still fails until a server update goes out, so new players may not show a badge yet. Badges from existing sign-ups are not affected.
- With Essential installed, the starfield background goes black while an Essential button on the title screen is hovered.

releases.notes:
A new look for every Nexo menu, plus a batch of new features. Minecraft 26.3, Fabric.

**New UI**
- Right-shift menu: a card grid with Minecraft item icons, search, and icon tabs for Settings, HUD Editor, Chat, Macros, Appearance and Accounts.
- Quick settings: opening a module from the menu gives a wide page with a searchable module list, an on/off switch, flat settings rows and a live preview of the module's HUD element, with Reset and Move on screen.
- Settings rows everywhere (vanilla's options too): name on the left, sliders with a rainbow track, value pills, on/off switches.
- HUD editor: grid, dashed boxes, only the elements that are switched on. The Target HUD and the toggle-sprint/sneak indicator can be moved now.
- Title screen: Nexo wordmark and button column, Essential's buttons in the bottom row, and on the right an account chip, the live Nexo player count, a "What's new" card, a Quick Join card with ping and player counts, and your player model.
- New Appearance setting "Title Screen Servers & News" turns off the server pings and the release-notes fetch.

**Fixes**
- HUD editor: boxes can be dragged again (Minecraft 26.3 numbers mouse buttons differently).
- Settings pages that only had an on/off switch are gone; those modules toggle straight from the menu.
- A broken or newer HUD layout file no longer breaks the HUD.

**New features since 0.7.1** include the target HUD, totem pop counter, hit flash, reach display, durability warning, auto-reconnect, stack counter, container search and chat tweaks (both editions), plus combat assist, ore highlight and player radar in Tactical.

**Known issue:** with Essential installed, the starfield background goes black while an Essential button on the title screen is hovered. The matrix rain background is not affected.
